hours.method: central = sum over channels of total videos x that channel's mean length (its own sample if 10+ videos were read, else the pooled mean); low/high = total videos x the first/third quartile of channel mean lengths

caveats: Lengths were read only for the most recent uploads of the 16 crawled channels (449 videos), so means lean towards recent uploads.
44 entries have no video count and are not in any total.
Shorts and clips pull the mean down; full sessions pull it up.
